description: A hospital bed with a white mattress, blue folded blanket, beige metal side rails, an adjustable frame and four caster wheels.
description_long: This is a wheeled hospital patient bed. The frame and side rails are a light grey-beige metal, the mattress is covered with a white sheet, and a blue blanket is folded over the foot end. The base sits on four black caster wheels and the head section is raised on an adjustable back rest.

description_short.five_words: wheeled hospital bed with blue blanket
